Data notes · November 2–8, 2026
Weekly activity uses Raw Data: 688 leads, 172 tours booked, 71 tours attended, and 12 leases. Lead Data supplies 654 individuals created in the reporting week, a 34-record difference from the summary (Berry Falls 7, Claxton Pecan 4, Hills at Hoover 10, Ingleside Terrace 4, Lamar Lofts 1, Landings at North Ingle 4, The Benton Apartment Homes 3, The Kenzie 1). The new workbook supplies historical lead records as well; these replace the corresponding earlier detail. Detail lists and recorded-cohort results cover supplied individuals only. 12 supplied records have a lease-signed date during the reporting week. The lease distribution differs: Landings has 3 weekly activity leases versus 4 dated detail records, while Ingleside has 1 versus 0. Calendar-month lease totals remain unavailable where signed-date detail differs from weekly activity in either direction. Application counts are blank in the source and remain unavailable. November goals total 77 across the supplied values; RATO, Santa Fe, Villa Siena Apartments have blank goals. Lamar Lofts has an explicit goal of zero. Blank goals remain unavailable and are excluded from pacing totals; the lease-goals portfolio goal remains unavailable until all goals are supplied. Portfolio occupancy totals require unit counts, which the source does not provide. Spend includes Google Ads, Meta, Zillow, Apartments.com, and Yelp. The existing policy uses Campaign - Meta for matching property/week records and Expense otherwise: current Meta campaign spend is $1,072.41 versus $923.11 in Expense. Dashboard spend is $15,115.26 versus $14,965.96 in Expense. Google campaign spend is $8,433.97 versus $8,433.96 in Expense. Meta reports 135 results; Villa Siena has a blank result count, so aggregate cost per result is unavailable. Facebook, Instagram, Meta, Meta Ads, Meta Ads Tour, and Paid Social are combined for channel CPL. Weekly rates compare event totals; cohort rates use matching supplied individuals. Reach sums campaign-reported values and is not deduplicated. November reporting-month totals begin November 2; November 1 is included in the October 26–November 1 reporting week, which Raw Data assigns to October. Reporting-month lead totals therefore differ from exact calendar-month totals. Benchmark targets, historical close-rate assumptions, and property groups follow the prior dashboard.

Dynamic Lead Goals

📐 Formula: Monthly Lead Goal is editable  ·  Weekly Lead Goal = Monthly Lead Goal ÷ 4.33  ·  Lead Gap = Weekly Goal − Actual (negative = ahead)  ·  ✅ ≥ 100% of weekly goal   ⚠️ 80–99%   🔴 < 80%

📐 Lease Goal Formula Reference
% to Goal = Signed Leases ÷ Monthly Lease Goal · Remaining = max(Goal − Signed, 0) · Expected by Now = Monthly Goal × % Month Elapsed · Pace vs Expected = Signed Leases − Expected by Now · Projected EOM = Signed Leases ÷ Days Elapsed × Days in Month. Current-month pacing uses the latest day actually included in the dashboard data.
